items.text: Glass for building can be now bought without having any DLC installed.
Greenhouse foundations no longer require conrete blocks.
Therefore, from now one you can build greenhouses without having to buy any DLCs.
We are very sorry for this oversight.
We thank our players for their vigilance and keeping in touch with us.
A new resource has appeared in Zalesie: Glass. Ask Steven for it.
With the help of glass and irreplaceable scrap metal, Kasimir can build greenhouses. Small and medium sized.
Plants grow faster in greenhouses, but not all plants are suitable for them.
Tekla has been practicing necromancy for years and has finally learned to resurrect dead animals. She can even bring poor departed Fluffy back to life, even if he was turned into ham long ago.
It pays to follow the November Soldier, as those hitherto useless skulls are precisely what Tekla needs for her mysterious rituals.
Thadeus modified the drawbars on wagons, trailers, and other machinery so they no longer detach every time Kasimir uses fast travel.
Kasimir discovered that buckets can be painted, and the paint won't just chip off for no reason.
Kasimir discovered that carpets can be hung on walls.
Kasimir learned how to rotate wall-mounted objects so that symmetrical patterns can be created. Art!
No one dares to take Kasimir's or his opponents's seat at the tavern game table anymore.
The availability of bottles in Zalesie has increased. Remember that they are sold not only by Sophia, but also by Helen and Ludvic from the sawmill.
The prankster who kept repainting the furniture in Kasimir's tavern a lovely shade of cyan has finally given it a rest.
Mayor Vladimir loves breaking Kasimir's tavern in various ways. We had a serious talk with him, and we hope he stops sabotaging his own business...

Organized locations and areas should scatter their contents only one last time, after which they will remember not to redo their setup every time Kazimierz steps away and comes back. A few items may still need to be tossed back where they belong.
When destroyed, organized locations and areas now properly 'release' the items stored inside them. Sometimes quite dramatically.
Tavern customers who managed to get permanently stuck are now able to free themselves. Just wait an hour and try not to look too closely at how they pulled it off.
If Anthony's contracts haven't been showing up for years on end, they will now function properly in the coming years.
Our game's demo and prologue no longer crash with an error.
Tavern's color should get back to normal and stay that way also when you load the game.
The trickster that kept repainting Kasimir's stuff pink while Kasimir was away got bored with the jokes.
The main story quest to paint the family homestead is ripe for the pickin' now.
We’re very sorry about the time you wasted on this.
We've gone and bled all the hydrogen right out of the water pumps and valves, so they won't go floating off into the sky no more.
Thadeus sure thinks he's a real comedian...

Thadeus is introducing a new technology to Zalesie: Waterworks! A small favor for our short inventor (and reading the relevant help panel) is all it takes to make buckets a thing of the past for Kasimir. But don't throw them away just yet, as this is a prototype water system, so the pressure might not be what you'd expect.
Steven has introduced as many as three (!) new colors for sale: yellow, brown, and black. Pure madness!
Kasimir has discovered that with the help of his crafting stool, he can mix paints together to get new shades.

Johnny has a new tool for sale: the Pickaxe. The first strike digs up gravel from under the ground, and the second reveals rocks. Yes, purely for decoration. The result of these actions can be covered up with a shovel.
Tekla, at Kasimir's urging, has introduced grass seeds for sale. So from now on, any dug-up patch of earth can be covered with lush green grass.
Tekla, also at Kasimir's urging, now sells "weeds" seedlings that everyone else cuts down: willow shrubs and maple trees.
In the Own Rules game mode, tool degradation can now be disabled.
All large buildings are now properly recognized when awarding achievements and in certain quests.
In the sewing station, you can now preview selected clothing before it is crafted.
The rooster no longer pulses like an alien creature while standing still.
Greenhouses
Photomode
Necromancy
The Woodcutter's Trailer now works as intended, and the related quest can be completed (or you can keep using the trailer as much as you like).
If a plant cannot be destroyed with a scythe, a shovel will definitely do the trick from now on. Except for ferns.
You can now use the shovel, hoe, and other tools on the gravel and sand areas of Kazimierz's farm as well.
Indestructible forest plants no longer grow on the default area of Kasimir's farm.
A small error in the tutorial made completing it impossible.
Wheelbarrow and pathmaker work properly now.
Parquet floors don't look like spread cardboard sheets anymore.
This time, we focused entirely on improving our game, especially on the aspects you reported as problematic.
The game was a proverbial step away from disaster due to constantly added content and a lack of optimization.
We had to significantly slim it down and optimize it.
The changes are significant, which is why we are resetting the version numbering and changing the middle digit.
If you encounter any issues launching the game, please reinstall it.
Those of you playing Farmer's Life on powerful PCs probably won't even notice the changes.
However, players for whom working on Kasimir's farm has been an absolute torment should be pleased.
If you had to lower the graphics quality to play comfortably, you can now try turning the settings up.
If you encounter any issues, you know where to find us. We'll help.
The update itself is large, but it significantly reduces the game's size on the disk.
The game now consumes nearly 1.5GB less RAM.
Proper division of assets in the game files has moved us away from the aforementioned disaster and will make it easier to add new content.
Thanks to smart texture management, our best models look even better, but only when it is necessary.
We analyzed the reasons why the game is so "heavy" and implemented dozens of improvements without any loss in visual quality.
We have slightly thinned out the vegetation in Zalesie, especially in places that the player usually only views from a distance anyway.
We optimized some of the models and improved their settings so they render more efficiently.
We reduced the size of large textures that can never be fully seen in all their glory anyway.
The shovel and the pathmaker no longer cause as much stuttering as before.
The eyeballs of storks flying a kilometer away from Kasimir are no longer being rendered...
All vehicles now use a new coupling system. Instead of flying off into the sky when they get jammed, the connection will safely break before a disaster occurs.
These new couplings are stable, do not jitter, and the angle limitation between connected machines works exactly as it should.
Vehicles no longer hitch together abruptly, but rather smoothly and gradually to minimize the chance of the "Kraken effect".
The small handcart finally behaves stably. This includes when it is attached to the bicycle!
We have adjusted the suspension of all machines, as well as their weights and centers of gravity, so they behave more predictably.
Machines with moving chassis parts, such as wagons, trailers, or the manure spreader, now have truly articulated components. Watch out when reversing!
Stall doors now open inward, and animals will never get caught on them.
All sheds and buildings have improved animals' navigation data, making them rarely get stuck.
If any of the animals "vanish into thin air," they will return to the farm area instead of somewhere far out in the woods.
If an animal being led into a stall is unable to reach it for some reason, it will return to its default behavior after a while, allowing you to interact with it again.
If the player has led an animal into a stall, the wife remembers this and will try to lead that same animal into the same stall, provided it is not occupied.
Horses make sounds less frequently, and we have eliminated the terrible background noise from their audio files.
The quest related to the "Woodcutter's Trailer" can now be continued, and saving during the quest and continuing the next day will no longer block your progress.
Completed tasks now unpin themselves automatically. We sincerely apologize for this glaring oversight.
We discovered the mystery behind the flying off furniture that you painstakingly arranged in your properties. This will not happen again.
Using the shortcut to drag only a single item no longer causes all items to be destroyed in certain cases (e.g., the chaff cutter).
Mine detonations now knock down trees, in accordance with the twins' quest.
The chainsaw no longer blocks jumping with a non-disappearing setting change option.
The Farmer's Eye now detects mushrooms in the forest as well.
Scythes now degrade even if the cut vegetation does not go straight into Kazimierz's bag.
"Infinite firewood trees" have now appeared in other locations and disappear (this time for good) from a single axe blow.
Certain agricultural machines could indeed be temporarily broken by driving in reverse. They are now reverse-proof.
It is no longer possible to commit theft during the introduction, which effectively prevented it from being completed.
Quests requiring the purchase of an animal now recognize if the player has already owned that animal for a long time.
It is no longer possible to duplicate Kazimierz's clothes for free using any chest.
Black onions are no longer black.
Mod support.
We are working on another DLC. It is too early to provide details, but it will introduce certain annual events that you should enjoy.
A new invention has arrived in Zalesie: the Woodcutter’s Trailer. Go ask Ludvic at the sawmill about it.
Kasimir has learned how to barrel ordinary wine and turn it into a premium vintage. Ask Helen for the details.
Kasimir has figured out how to make neat firewood piles and put together large pallets of boards. Check your building menu.
Kasimir has learned how to set up organized zones which — just like wagons and trailers — keep everything tidy on their own.
Kasimir has (finally!) learned how to pour well water into empty bottles.
Kasimir has learned how to pin quests. They’ll stay right there in the top right corner almost all the time now.
We’ve added a separate slider for music volume. It’ll change the gramophones' volume too.
Henry isn’t just standing stubbornly in the middle of the road anymore. Now, he’s stubbornly patrolling the main crossroad, so you’d best watch out for him.
The folk of Zalesie are following Sophia’s lead and are making better use of whatever lamps and lights they have.
That "best" treasure hunt quest of ours can now be cut short just by digging in the right spot at the end.
Signboards now let you write across three lines.
Cats and dogs won't be catching any more sicknesses caused by Kasimir’s livestock herds being too crowded.
The game now gives a clearer word that the introduction can be continued. (You don't have to start from the very beginning every time.)
You can’t go riding horses during the introduction anymore.
Burek won’t be pestering players with surveys in the main menu the moment they’ve just turned on the game for the first time.
The help panels that pop up won't "force" you to read every single thing at once anymore. They’ll only show the topic you actually need.
The help menu has received a few new pages of information.
Missing characters for Korean and Chinese languages have been filled in.
You can now use a pitchfork to load rapeseed straight onto a wagon or trailer.
When fixing up sandwiches and jam buns, Kasimir has actually started putting the jam in them.
The broken road to the State Farm was finally fixed. The tractor no longer submerges into it to a devastating effect.
The bug causing the terrain to go "all green" was found and squashed. Thanks Szwagier for help!
Another batch of missing translations was added (for languages other than Polish and English)
The wheels of our new animal trailer are unstuck and spin the way they supposed to.
Missing translations have been added.
Overlapping UI elements (certainly not all of them) have been corrected.
Wild grass flickering has been significantly reduced, especially on higher graphic quality settings.
Settings affecting how much the game can strain the players' eyes have been adjusted.
It is now much easier to identify items that the merchant you are currently speaking with wants to buy from you.
A bug reducing performance on Ultra and Hyper settings has been eliminated.
The old horse-drawn plow is now operated exactly like all other farming machinery.
The game tutorial section has been expanded with several elements, and some topics are now better explained.
It is now harder to get lost during the tutorial.
New crops have arrived in Zalesie: Hops and Grapes. Go ask Maria and Tekla for some seeds.
Kasimir has learned how to brew beer (the dark kind too) and make wine (in three different sorts). You can buy the tools from Helen, and there’s tips in the help menu if you need them.
Stan from the State Farm is now selling trailers for hauling beasts. No more dragging the herd along on foot.
Kasimir can change the rules of the game to "Own Rules" by visiting Father Mateusz and picking "Change your life."
Kasimir figured out how to top up the big animal feeders using a pitchfork.
We found out why the animals were getting stuck in their stalls and fixed it. They still tend to navigate poorly, but they won't be "unusable" no more.
Field kitchens won't be resetting their fireplates after you load back into the game.
Quests that got stuck (like setting up the orchard) will now unlock and count as finished, if you’ve actually done the work.
Holding down the Control key will now let you drag just one piece of an item at a time.
The distillery won't ask how much mash you want to throw in no more, since you can only fit one lot anyway.
You can now pick up jars from the carts, so you don't have to sell the whole cart just to clear it out.
The inside of the tavern is now kept warm by the stove in the back room.
Tekla still hits hard as ever, but it’ll take fewer good strikes to bring her down now.
The folk of Zalesie who got stuck on their way to the tavern will sort themselves out now. Just wait a few hours and they’ll be on their way.
The terrain of Zalesie (specifically its textures) was accidentally affected during the previous update.
We have restored it to its default state; however, those of you who noticed issues with your crops during gameplay will likely need to revert to a save file where the crops appear correctly.
We sincerely apologize for the confusion and for any time you lost because of this mistake.
Steven and his crew, while no one was looking, provided Kasimir with a well right by the tavern.
The tavern menu available to customers now includes items stored inside furniture, such as sideboards or chests.
Meals warmed up for customers no longer magically return to the player’s inventory.
The first DLC (Pimp My Cottage) is no longer required to purchase tavern equipment.
It is also no longer needed to unpack that equipment and place it wherever you like.
Kasimir now knows how to cut strawberry pie into more than one slice.
Construction quests that were stuck and no longer displayed the blueprint can now be completed.
Kasimir discovered that it's possible to stand on a ladder and edit the tavern sign or any other board at the same time.
Father Matthew has remembered where he misplaced the dance floors for Kasimir’s tavern.
Tavern customers will no longer try to enter the establishment through the back room.
The furniture color scheme chosen by the player will no longer reset to default after loading the game.

notes.title: State Farm are came back to normal, which means

items.text: you can lead your animals into the sales pen
huge white boxy thing is gone
the entrance gate is back where it should be
Buildable signposts (small and big) came back to normal. Changing displayed text TEST to something more appropriate may be required.

notes.title: Kitchen and Beets Update Now Live

items.text: Hey Farmers! 👋
The Kitchen and Beets update is now available — and it arrives alongside the freshly released Farmer’s Life – Booze Bites Bets DLC 🍻🎉
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/5559e38be59f5114c83c99e34581a44ec682173f.png"]

This update focuses on expanding food production, farming options, and overall game quality. At the same time, the new DLC lets you turn that mysterious building near the church into a fully functional tavern. Let’s take a look at what’s new!
Cakes can now be cut into slices, making them easier to sell and use.
Some recipes now produce more than one item, improving efficiency and bulk production.
Baked goods prices have been adjusted to increase the profitability of selling them.
A brand-new workstation is now available in sheds, concrete buildings, and the barn:
Field Kitchen — perfect for large-scale mash production. Let the mass brewing begin!
Beetroot has been added as a new crop.
cooking borscht,
feeding animals,
and as an ingredient for chopped feed.
Fried potatoes
Mashed potatoes
Red borscht
Performance optimizations (faster dynamic reflections, more efficient farms on purchased plots).
UI improvements and fixes (overlapping or cut-off texts, clarity improvements).
The “strange building near the church” has finally disappeared —
Booze Bites Bets 🍻
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/"]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51641/Farmers_Life_Ultimate_Bundle/"]
We’re excited to see what you cook, grow, and build next!
Happy farming! 🚜

topNew: Cakes can now be cut into slices, making them easier to sell and use.
Some recipes now produce more than one item, improving efficiency and bulk production.
Baked goods prices have been adjusted to increase the profitability of selling them.

notes.title: On the occasion of the sale, in addition to the Farmer's Life update, we have a surprise for you – we are announcing a new DLC!

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967800/Farmers_Life__Booze_Bites_Bets_DLC/"] We were planning to show you a lot more new content with this free update, but we still need to polish it up. So we kindly ask for a little more patience, and as a consolation, we’re sharing a small glimpse of our work so far.
Thadeus has an idea for a new invention: the Pathmaker. It’s a clever device for creating paths. A shovel can at best be used to tidy up its work.
Thadeus is now selling new equipment: wheelbarrows. Simple, old, wooden wheelbarrows. They can be used to carry items, but also loaded with manure or compost.
Stan has a new farming machine for sale: the horse-drawn harrow. It works like a cultivator attached to a tractor, but is pulled by a horse. (In the future, we’ll add the option for two horses.)
While sleeping, Kasimir can now learn even more useful facts about the game of which he is the unwitting hero.
It's just a mandatory font update we had to do.
If you experience any kind of problems with texts in the game, let us know!
Players having problems with loading the game should try again now.
Some of you experienced issues loading the game. Thanks to your reports, we’ve identified the problem and everything should now work as intended.
Maria at the State Farm still buys strawberries, but this time she actually pays for them.
The control key descriptions now mention jumping and throwing.
This time, jumping with a controller really works (default: B button). Sorry for the oversight.
We discovered that at lower framerates, rolling cigarettes was nearly impossible — whether using a keyboard or a controller. This action now works independently of FPS.
Traps set out in the forests are now more likely to catch animals.
The mysterious white building near the church has disappeared — but it’ll be back.

notes.title: Working on the farm has never been so fun. The sun is shining, not too cold, not too warm, before the Summer Holidays... and with an Update!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/aaf6caf7762c9c941c9c663077fc752d6d1ab8fd.png"]

notes.title: What's changed in Farmer's Life Update 1.0.34

items.text: Thadeus has an idea for a new invention: the Mechanical Chainsaw. Before he starts selling it, however, you'll need to complete a few tasks for him.

Helen also has an idea for a new invention: the Cigarette Roller. Once mounted on a work stool, it greatly simplifies the process of producing tobacco products — but first, you'll need to finish a few jobs for Helen.
Hand-rolling cigarettes can now be done not only with the mouse, but also using the up/down keys or the forward/backward joystick axis.
Kasimir has finally overcome his fear of jumping. If he builds up enough speed and isn't overburdened, he can even jump over fences! (Some activities prevent jumping.)
Kasimir realized the attic in his old house has stood unused for years. It can now be accessed and used via an outside entry.
Kasimir has learned to organize space better, so all cabinets, dressers, and other furniture now have double the capacity.
Kasimir can now access item containers even while standing on a ladder.
Stefan discovered that the ladders he sells were too long and cumbersome for some people. From now on, he also offers medium and short versions.
Stan from the State Farm has — completely free of charge (!) — mounted small toolboxes on all of Kasimir’s tractors for the most essential tools.
Fences built by Kasimir now try their best to look better on uneven terrain. Still not perfect, but an improvement nonetheless.
Kasimir has learned to search wild dumps more thoroughly. In addition to scrap, he now finds bottles, jars, boards, and other small items.
When selling directly from wagons, items that the merchant isn't interested in are now greyed out, just like in regular hand-to-hand trade.
Plows and harrows "sample" the soil more frequently, leaving fewer missed patches.
Kasimir can now choose the color of livestock he wants to purchase.
Kasimir discovered that straw can be used to line animal pens using a pitchfork. This improves cleanliness, post-birth recovery, milk yield, and wool regrowth.
Kasimir also found that feeders can be placed in pens in such a way that they don’t get in the animals’ way (i.e., near the doors or the opposite side).
The issue with animals crowding into a single stall in the barn has been resolved. You’ll just need to rescue them one last time.
The same fix applies to animals “automatically” returning to stalls they shouldn't — unless your wife has told them to.
Automatic milkers will no longer attempt to milk bulls, male goats. Or calves.
Automatic milkers no longer appear in regular old animal pens (in brick buildings).
The spots where you removed old fences near the house can now be cultivated like any other soil.
The “Fresh Milk” quest (for Sophia) now accepts either a cow or a goat and also counts milk from automatic milkers.
Maria at the State Farm now buys strawberries.
Turns out some prankster painted our male geese to look like barnacle geese. After a bath, it’s clear they’re just normal saddleback males.
Wives no longer walk around barefoot after coming back from work.
Floating socks in the yard should no longer haunt Kasimir’s farm.
Cats and dogs can now enter Kasimir’s house. Cats sleep in the kitchen — whether Kasimir likes it or not.
Save file deletion is now much more convenient. You can even delete all files at once — so be careful!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/"]
Enjoy your farming,

Kasimir has learned how to build modern animal stalls. (Outdated stalls must be destroyed before placing new ones.) If the building housing the new stall has a completed electrical installation, cows and goats inside will milk themselves. The collected milk accumulates in a tank and must be gathered manually.
Bags, packages, crates, and other handheld containers can now be thrown towards chests and storage structures.
The harvester, chaff cutter, and threshing machine have been given a bag-ejecting function. This makes it easy to transfer the output from these machines onto a cart, trailer, or into storage.
Kasimir can now instantly assess the contents of any cart or trailer.
You no longer have to sell everything directly from the cart or trailer. You can precisely choose what and how much Kasimir will sell to each trader.
If Kasimir parks the seeder right next to a storage or seed chest, he can quickly transfer large amounts of seeds using the UI.
Larger quantities of milk no longer appear as a regular sack. We now have a nice, classic milk can.
You can now get rid of the indestructible hollyhocks and sunflowers growing near the house.
Dismantling and packing up a wardrobe or cupboard will no longer destroy everything stored inside.
Using sourdough for bread now returns an empty jar.
A new cow color variant has appeared in Zalesie: the classic black and white dairy cow.
When purchasing items that don’t appear directly in your inventory, the camera now clearly shows where they’ve been placed.
The journal now contains a list of all completed quests.
We’ve improved the appearance of mature rapeseed, but the sowing season remains unchanged. We're not ready for winter crops just yet.
When trimming branches from a felled tree, they now go directly into Kasimir's inventory.
You can jump off a ladder even if there’s no nearby surface to safely land on.
From time to time, we’ll bother you with questions. Please don’t ignore Fluffy asking for attention in the main menu. With your help, we’ll make Farmer’s Life an even better game!
The newer tractor is now slightly more powerful, because it's a shame for it to pull a plow at the same speed as Kasimir's old tractor.
Chickens lay eggs, and cows and goats fill their udders at the same time every day, regardless of the season. This way, wives always have time to take care of them before heading to work.

notes.title: Just to let you know, our publisher has 3 important announcements lately

items.text: 1. Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos - a crazy co-op "cleaning simulator" has announced Kickstarter:
2. House Builder 2 - a sequel of the first (and only?) simulator where you can build all over the world and throughout the history now gets a demo. Check it out:
3. Aquarist has a new DLC launch and big sale today, so if you still haven't get it now will be the best time. Here is a bundle with Farmer's Life:
Enjoy,
Farmer's Life team
the harvester (you worked hard to get) is now able to process your new canola (aka rapeseed) fields properly
Poltry specimens packed into crates no longer looses its fatness or any other stats.
Strawberries of Zalesie lost their mega-power of hydration and nourishment.
Strawberry bushes are no longer green all year long. They change their looks as the year goes by.
Both Alice and Sophia buy bread and breadrolls from Kasimir now.
Corrections in quest descriptions
Missing translations for Italian have been added
Refreshed vegetation and collision system in and around the new mill area
Fixes of bugs reported by players
If your save file fails to load or your progress is lost, it was due to our error related to tree cutting. It should now be fixed.

The hand mill from the miller will no longer appear high up in the air... If you need help with your save file (to remove floating machines), please send a bug report and leave a return address or contact me at bartek@freemind.pl.
Areas where anything has been planted now stand out more, so you won’t need to use the Landlord's Vision so often.
Fishing with a levitating rod in TPP mode is no longer possible.
Performing pirouettes with a spinning dead animal during outfit changes is no longer possible.
Partition walls in concrete buildings are no longer holographic illusions. Solid concrete will stop everything (except chickens, probably).
The cultivator no longer attempts aggressive attacks on the tractor during attachment.
Attaching machines to horses and tractors is now more precise and (most often) selects the correct target rather than a much farther one.
Kazimierz has learned to sell clothes he’s made himself. Jasiek (the tool guy) will gladly accept them, but not in bulk quantities.

Our Discord link in the main menu is now correct.: Yes, the changes are not very significant, but it's because we are working on something big.: Just to let you know, in just few days,: Aquatic Store Simulator: is coming out on Steam.: Wishlist now, and celebrate with us the release on November 5.: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Store_Simulator/

After the 1.0.24 update, all players noticed "plowed" and untouchable areas next to the barn on Kasimir's farm. This is a side effect of our tests. It has ben reverted, but some of you may need to re-plow these areas using any method.
We remind you that if there is more than one animal in a stall at a time, take out the ones you can using "take animal out" and for the rest, use the lead option and take advantage of fast travel.
From now on, they shouldn't experience this shared overnight stay anymore.
Chickens are avoiding the use of teleportation, so if they’re stuck somewhere, you’ll need to help them. Or end their suffering if they’re out of your reach.
The cultivator no longer behaves as if it’s still working after being detached from the tractor.
Falling off the bicycle no longer results in a Buddha-like effect or strange positions while continuing to ride.
Building construction now removes not only grass but also larger vegetation.
Chickens no longer treat doors to concrete buildings as if they don't exist.
The shape of entry ramps to concrete buildings has been improved, so poultry should no longer have trouble getting inside.
The two-wheeled cart has been "calmed down" a bit, but in collisions with other equipment, it can still explode. We're investigating the issue and will implement the necessary fixes.
Loading save files from before the update should no longer cause issues.
Kazimierz's movement has returned to normal.

Using fast travel on a bicycle no longer ends with a trip to the sky or beneath the terrain.: Important: If you played and saved the game after receiving a message about an incorrectly loaded file, I suggest starting from a save file made before the update.: This will help you avoid unexpected losses that may have occurred due to the incorrect file loading.: Before releasing the update, we tested many of your save files, but as you can see, not thoroughly enough.: We sincerely apologize for the problems caused.
Clothes
Kasimir has discovered that he can live without his beloved cap on his head. In fact, the rest of his clothes can also be swapped for something else.
Clothing affects body temperature. During harsh winters, a bearskin outfit will allow long hours outdoors. But on hot days, it's better to wear something lighter. Or nothing at all.
Johnny at the Zalesie market has started selling clothes. If you want to look like the Mayor, be sure to talk to our toolsmith.
If winter is raging in your game right now, at least get yourself a sweater.
Kasimir can now set up a new station: the sewing workshop. Only here can clothes be made from the skins of hunted animals. You can also create woolen string and dresses.
As part of Johnny's tasks, you can obtain two types of military uniforms.
Kasimir can gift selected clothing to the women of Zalesie, and they will put it on immediately.
Kasimir's wife changes into something more comfortable for the night than her work clothes.
When winter comes, the residents of Zalesie dress appropriately instead of freezing in light clothing.
Kasimir now reacts to temperature changes faster, so it no longer takes several hours by the stove to warm up.: Third person camera (optional)
While driving vehicles and riding animals, you can now switch between first-person and third-person camera views.
Regardless of the work mode, the camera now behaves differently, no longer shaking with the vehicle, making the ride more enjoyable.
Yes, you can now see Kazimierz in his current outfit not only during outfit changes but also while riding.
No, you won't be seeing a third-person camera while walking anytime soon.: Other
A long-awaited option has appeared in the graphic settings: antialiasing, with several variants.
Kasimir has learned how to sort items in his vast bag, making it easier to find things.
If Kasimir misses a needlessly sold tractor or another unusual vehicle, he can always talk to Stan and buy back the chosen machines.
Kasimir discovered that the music records he owns contain additional tracks he hadn't heard before!
Horses now only use bridles and harnesses when they are actually needed.
Agricultural machines once again provide resistance during operation.
Animals (yes, including chickens and roosters) now have much fewer opportunities to escape from their pens or disappear.
Animals will no longer appear in the same stalls. However, if you've already experienced this, lead out those you can, and rescue the rest by leading them and using fast travel.
Memory usage during gameplay has been significantly reduced.

releases.displayName: Farmer's Life - The Cultivator Update Available Now!

items.text: A new machine has appeared in Zalesie: the cultivator. With its help, you can restore lightly overgrown soil after winter much more efficiently than with a plow. Ask Staszek in the PGR.
It's no longer possible to impale the chopper on the pitchfork.
No one will take away Kazek's wallpapers that were applied on previously painted walls.
Another batch of our mistakes and oversights has been eliminated.
Apparently, we forgot to mention that DLC owners can paint their furniture, both purchased and those initially available in Kasimir's house. So, we are boasting about it now.
Kasimir has learned to build the third and final type of building from concrete blocks. It is elongated, single-story, and accommodates many stalls.
New roofing materials have appeared in Zalesie: sheet metal and tiles. You can paint them! Ask Stefan in the center.
Constructed buildings without stalls are no longer indestructible.
The horse-drawn digger no longer drifts majestically.
The tractor-drawn seeder no longer vibrates and drifts to the side.
Kasimir can now arrange the interior of the old barn as he wishes. You can even remove all the stalls and set up a moonshine distillery inside.
Kasimir has learned to build a new type of building using concrete blocks.
Kasimir has learned to build simple dog houses for his dogs.
Connections between machines (e.g., tractor with a trailer) are now more stable. Swaying has been eliminated.
A cart hitched to a horse still sways. Exactly as in reality. We've checked.
Pulling bags, boxes, crates, and barrels straight from the inventory near machines no longer causes them to fly off into space.
You can now sell the s60 engine, table saw, and chopper to the residents who sell them.
You can sell the old tractor, new tractor, motorcycle, and even the combine harvester to Stan at the State Agricultural Farm (SAF). Such a sale is irreversible!
Using solvent on the floor no longer removes wallpaper and paint from the entire interior.
You can no longer paint the floor. It may have looked nicer, but it led to unpleasant consequences.
You can no longer accidentally mow tree seedlings with a scythe. You have to take a shovel and dig them up.
You can now rotate bales of straw or hay while holding them in your hands. They also don’t fall from the attics when the player moves too far away.
The building and station destruction mode now gives time to react to stop the process if it is used on the wrong object by mistake.
You can now use fast travel while holding a ladder in your hands.
Animals should now stop disappearing. They may still change their position in surprising ways. We are working to ensure they stay in their enclosures.
Steven now offers a larger amount of asbestos sheets and concrete blocks.
Metal stalls for animals in concrete buildings no longer change into wooden ones without reason.
Interior furnishings introduced by DLC no longer duplicate.
You can no longer use "Take all" when the item quantity slider is open.
The issue with the game not recognizing the horse being led into the stall (in the introduction) has finally been identified and eliminated.
Trees planted by Kasimir, after being cut down and the stump dug out with a shovel, no longer leave an eternally "treed" spot.
Stacks of grass, hay, etc., hold 40 units of the resource. The same as a single bale of the resource.
Inside new farm buildings, it no longer rains.
Machines overturned in an unfortunate manner are easier to set upright.
The description of a fresh egg no longer causes confusion regarding poultry breeding. All you need is a rooster and a flock of hens. Eggs do not participate in the process.
In addition to the above, we have managed to identify and fix a huge number of bugs. Of course, all thanks to you, dear players!
Cultivator.
Concrete, multi-stall pigsty.
New types of roofing materials.

Cats don't fall trough terrain to keep dropping into the void and break the interaction system.: If "I can't interact with anything" issue still persists after this hotfix, please, contact me directly via bartek@freemind.pl or trough our Discord.
Wives have stopped sulking and can now find their way to bed instead of wandering around the house all night.
Dogs and cats are no longer afraid to follow their owner inside the house.
Ambrose now buys unwanted tablecloths and napkins.
Moving curtains, furniture, and other furnishings no longer results in the displacement of nearby items.
Your new furniture "installed" right from the cart (or a trailer) will not move with the cart (or the trailer).
Putting down carpets no longer ends in them levitaning along Kasimir's body.
The wardrobe package no longer performs its magic trick of orientation changing.
Urgent setting changes for bugreporting server.
Compressed cubes of hay, straw, etc. now hold even more content. One cube can now fit an entire loose pile.
Apple trees bear fruit every year now. If there are no apples visible on the trees, make sure your spouse hasn't already moved them to the pantry.

The "Family Treasure" task should no longer pose problems in tracking down the next clue. Clue's visibility in fog or during storms has also been changed. We hope the livers of your Kazimierz will forgive us.
To race against Staszek with the new tractor standing in his workshop, you first need to obtain that tractor as part of the game's storyline.
We have attempted to address the issue of the game crashing after loading certain save files.
Milking cows and goats inside the boxes should no longer cause them any harm.

The link to our Discord in the main menu finally leads to the correct server.: We know it doesn't look like much work has been done.: However, we ask for your patience as we are working on something bigger.: Something that will address several of your most frequently suggested ideas.
We've improved the readability of the information conveyed in the game's introduction.
Kazimierz has learned how to build two new types of garage sheds. They are perfect as a garage for a combine harvester or as a roof for distillery farms.
Physically active stacks of items (barrels, bags, boxes, cubes, etc.) now constitute an obstacle for animal navigation.
While plowing with horses, it's no longer necessary to manually ensure the camera is facing the right direction.
Pop-up notifications are now more readable.
Dead animals left on the ground decompose on their own after a few months.
In the summer, herbivorous animals become hungry much slower, but they do not replace the mower or scythe. Grass still needs to be removed manually.
Unwanted stacks of hay, grass, straw, etc., can be removed by burning them with the help of a kerosene lamp. The same applies to cubes and hay drying racks. The racks themselves are fire-resistant.
Chaff cutters and threshers can be loaded by throwing the appropriate items onto them, both in cubes and in loose form using forks.
Mowing now generates significantly less grass. This applies to both the scythe and the mower, as well as the combine harvester.
Grass and its rotting derivatives do not turn into rotten mush after winter but simply decompose and disappear without a trace.
It's possible to spear cubes on forks and throw them. The cubes, not the forks.
Animals can now be cleaned by dousing them with water from a bucket.
It's now possible to milk cows and goats without taking them out of their stalls. Remember, even locked stalls can feed... remotely. Just let them out for a walk sometimes, ok?
Kazimierz can use fast travel even when overloaded. But travelling on foot, on bike or an animal might take more time, depending on carried weight.
The sound range of animal footsteps is now significantly reduced.
Two new volume sliders have appeared in the settings: for our "dialogs" (otherwise known as mumbling) and for Kazimierz's footsteps.
The range of the mouse sensitivity slider in the settings has been significantly widened.
The availability of scrap at Stefan's and the twins at the sawmill has increased.
The production of vodka (based on oat mash) is now just as profitable as the production of other alcohols.
Using the map through the inventory button no longer drops the boxes carried in hands, allowing for the use of fast travel with boxes in hands when playing with a controller.
Picking up items from wagons or trailers will no longer cause explosions or jittering. However, a solid displacement of the vehicle can still occur, because Kazek is really a strong guy.
Priest Mateusz has discovered a new tradition of the Kazimierz family and has an idea for a related new task.
We have made another attempt to fix the issue with the cursor being locked in the middle of the screen for players using advanced controllers, such as those for flight simulators.

For other players, the only noticeable change should be that 'controller mode' activates upon pressing a button on the controller. Tilting any of the sticks, pressing a trigger, or using the D-pad will no longer activate this mode.
We will closely monitor your reactions and, if necessary, we will also revert this change.
Wives now perform some tasks in the evening (e.g., moving animals into pens, cleaning animals, etc.), and the rest early in the morning.
Wives can repair damaged tools, both those in the player's inventory and those stored in the pantry or the chest by the bed.
We have abandoned the idea of automatically disabling controller detection meant to help players whose cursor got stuck in the middle of the screen.
This change has harmed other players.
We will try to find another solution to this problem as soon as possible.
Wives have changed their approach to their tasks. If the relationship with the husband is perfect, they try to complete all assigned tasks.
The worse the relationship with the husband, the fewer tasks will be completed.
The work-sharing window highlights in green all the tasks that will be completed the next morning.
All tasks assigned to the wives are performed early in the morning just before going to work.
Kazimierz has learned to build a new slightly wider entrance gate.
Stan allows racing with the new tractor as well. But he only drives his faithful machine.
Composters now also accept bales of grass, hay, etc.
Fonts for Chinese and Korean languages have been rebuilt. It seems that they finally display properly in every part of the game.
We restored earning of Steam achievements.
Continuing the game should report the ones you earned to Steam.
If it doesn't you need to go back in time (load appropriate save file) and try again.
(And then go back to your latest savegame).
Za utrudnienia bardzo przepraszamy.
Take care of your wives' good mood.
The worse your relationship with them, the fewer tasks they will complete in a day.
You can now carry more than one crate of chickens at the same time.
You can destroy (using the building menu): the default composter, the default manure pit, the default crate in the barn, and the outhouse built on the farm.
Items left in the harbor area no longer sink into the ground when you leave the harbor.

Automatic controller detection turns off if it detects conflicting signals that lock the cursor in the middle of the screen, which should free the cursor and allow the game to be used with a mouse and keyboard.
Wives milk more cows.
The availability of string has increased in Zalesie.
Twine loaded into the combine harvester will no longer disappear without a trace after loading the game.
Steven now has a larger amount of asbestos boards for sale.
Maria from the State Owned Farm has arranged for a greater quantity of seeds for sale.
A strange construction error in the motorcycle has been eliminated.
The game has left Early Access, so it no longer mentions at the start what will await players in the full version of the game.
Some texts describing new tasks have become a bit more informative.

notes.title: IV. We have managed to get some great deals on this occasion

items.text: HERE ARE THE FIRST FULL RELEASE UPDATE

notes.title: What can the combine harvester do

items.text: Mow oats, wheat, or corn, thresh them while driving, and pack the resulting grains into bags.
Store large amounts of harvested grain and throw away the excess in bags. Check the bag space on the left side.
Create cubes (if there is enough string) or drop loose piles if the driver so desires.
Mow the grass like a giant lawn mower.
Collect loose piles (grass, hay, oats, wheat, straw) and turn them into cubes. Just don't forget to turn on the press.
Barely fit through the entrance gates. This beast takes up the entire width of the road!
Burn a lot of fuel. But he has a huge tank.
Take huge amounts of string so that you never run out of it for dicing. Check out the press in the back.

notes.title: What a combine harvester cannot do

items.text: Squeeze into the current vehicle garage. But if you insist, you can park it in the barn.
Collect fruits from raspberry and blueberry bushes. However, it effectively destroys them.
Become damaged. Yes, it is a really solid construction.

notes.title: How to get a combine harvester?

items.text: If you have already completed the main storyline (letters in a bottle), check your journal.
If you haven't completed the main storyline, complete it :)
New wider entrance gates.
Larger version of the garage. If a combine can fit in it, anything can fit in it.: Have fun farming
Farm animals that for some reason shot too high above the ground are no longer teleported far to the west.
Farm animals crowded in a pen and frightened will still jump, but much lower than before.: (We suspect that these two points were the main cause of animals disappearing from the farm.)
Farm animals have minimized their teleportation through obstacles like fences or gates.
Farm animals using feeders placed near fences (or walls) can no longer teleport to the other side of these fences (or walls).

Farm animals are now less fearful, but if chased by a tractor, they will still try to run away. Not always successfully.: (We suspect that these three points were the main cause of animals escaping from enclosed pens.)
The Czech translation has been corrected and updated (Thanks SniperKittenCZ!)
You can now assist in the birth of a calf without the risk of spraining a finger from clicking the mouse or controller button.
Plowing with the help of a horse and controller now works correctly.
Visiting the parents' grave at the churchyard cemetery now activates letters from a stranger (if the player continues the game after completing the Prologue).
The fonts for the Chinese language have been regenerated and no longer display mostly squares.
The ability to assign D-pad buttons and a slightly different approach to quick access to items (when the player uses a controller).
Investigation of the issue with disappearing and escaping animals. And, of course, solving this problem.
Hay (not to be confused with the fresh grass) left in loose heaps will no longer disappear after loading the game.
You can now consume food directly from the pantry, crates, bags, and other containers for food products.
In the control settings, you can now clear the assignment of a button or key.
We've cleaned up the confusion caused by incorrect Steam Input settings. At least, we hope so.
The ability to assign D-pad buttons and a slightly different approach to quick access to items (when the player uses a controller).
Investigation of the issue with disappearing and escaping animals. And, of course, solving this problem.
The game now supports controllers and automatically detects when you are using one.
In the game settings, you can disable automatic controller detection if the game detects a device that you neither want to use nor disconnect.
Most buttons can be freely reassigned. The exceptions are the D-pad and the axes for movement and looking around.
If the game displays incorrect button labels for your controller, try changing the "button layout" option in the settings.
The camera work while riding on animals no longer requires constant correction of the viewing direction during turns.
Kasimir now dries off much faster when wet, especially near a lit stove.
Kasimir's spouse now collects significantly more manure (however, it's necessary to ensure an adequate number of empty manure pits).
Kasimir's spouse now collects significantly more eggs.
Kasimir's spouse now introduces significantly more animals.
Manure pits and composters are now twice as capacious (therefore, the visual level of filling has seemingly dropped by half).
Most races can be run on animals of either gender, so nothing stands in the way of defeating stallion Filip on the back of a mare.
Our beloved Tekla is finally starting to feel her age. Our fistfight champion is now slightly less combative, but still not to be underestimated.
Disappearing animals find their way back to their beloved farm. The reason for their disappearance, unfortunately, remains shrouded in mystery.
If you've disabled the use of Steam Cloud, the game will no longer create huge logs that disrupt the operation of the bug reporting tool.
Painting buildings will no longer disappear after reloading the game.
Owners of vast cultivated fields will notice that the game now saves even faster.
Missing symbols have been supplemented in the French translation.
Numerous corrections have been introduced in the Russian translation from our wonderful community. Thank you, Jay Lee!
With the help of players, we've been able to track down and eliminate many irritating bugs.
The bees go back the hives in the summer. But hives built in the summer might not be found by bees. You need to build them earlier or wait for the next summer.
The "speed bumps" on our crossroads were eliminated.
Introductionary tutorial was changed to make sure everyone learns how to put animals inside their pens properly.
Animals bought by Kasimir are automatically led by him. This will prevent "loosing" them when going back home either by fast travel or without any shortcuts.
Forest animals will not spawn outside world's boundaries nor will they venture beyond them.
Few of the achievements (like "Zalesie Explorer" or "Where the past meets the present") are now obtainable. Some of you just need to continue playing and you will be awarded.
Multiple repeating notifications are reduced to minimum. For example those regarding readiness of all your mushroom farms.
The game now saves its state MUCH faster than before. Especially those with larger cultivated fields will feel this improvement.
Kerosene lamps now burn fuel. Remember to turn them off if they're not needed. Or switch to electric lighting.
Trailers and wagons now have more effective brakes and won't roll down an incline without reason.
A picked up distillery now returns all the fuel and mash (if it remained untouched).
You can no longer "produce" honey by the method: place a beehive in the summer, collect honey, destroy the beehive, place it again, and repeat.
From now on, Kazimierz has permission to build and electrify within his farm's area right from the start.
Bales of hay/grass/wheat/oats/straw are now more spacious.
The motorcycle's trunk has become more spacious, and the water pots in the kitchen and distilleries are larger.
Seeds now take up significantly less space in the inventory.
Barrels for liquids no longer fit in Kazimierz's pocket. They must be carried by hand or transported in another way.
Barrels with liquids and fuel barrels are now much harder to tip over.
Stacks of grass/hay/straw/oats/wheat have been significantly optimized. This includes the contents of hay drying racks and wagons.
Buckets and other items placed on furniture will no longer fall to the floor or ground. This time for sure.
The unexplained disappearance of animals should now be significantly reduced.
We've fixed another large batch of bugs that you've reported to us.
All the game save files you've sent us that wouldn't load now do so without issues.
From now on, the residents of Zalesie also accept meals prepared by Kazimierz as gifts. Everyone has their favorites.
Detaching the seeder from the tractor no longer leads to an "explosion" and scattering of both machines in the vicinity.
Achievements on Steam are now correctly described and illustrated. They will be available to earn when the game leaves Early Access on October 20th.
We've managed to improve the game's performance in many aspects. This will be especially noticeable on extensive farms owned by advanced players.
We've fixed a massive number of bugs that you continue to report tirelessly, and for that, we sincerely thank you.
Mowing grass with a large plow no longer leaves spots with invisible grass that cannot be sowed.
The tractor, motorcycle, and bicycle no longer start rolling down a hill as soon as you get on them.
In the game settings, you can now disable the FPS counter display.
"Treasure chests" now float down the river current, but you'll need a boat to retrieve them.
Using a flail to obtain grains from a stack of oats or wheat no longer makes the remaining straw unavailable.
Vehicles and machinery are now slightly easier to move using Kasimir's tired hands.
All damaged parts of the new tractor can now be repaired.
A second horse can now be hitched to wagons. The wagon won't move any faster, but it looks nice.
We've added support for the Czech, Hungarian, and Portuguese languages.
Fresh grass cubes no longer disappear after loading the game. However, those already lost will sadly not return.
If the main storyline of the game is completed, a dock with a boat will appear by the river on the road from the "town center".
You can now sail the river and fish from the boat (especially in places where they bite well).
Numerous bugs have been successfully fixed.
The error counter will no longer display at the top of the screen, but you can reinstate it in the game options if you suspect something is amiss with the game.
The new tractor now fits in the garage, even with the cabin set up.
Dream tips now contain more guidance, and the Help menu explains how to manage farms on developed plots.
Performance has been improved on more complex farms.
Horses no longer stomp when standing in the paddock.
Storks and crows should now land more easily on the ground after being shot down.
After meeting the person writing letters to Kasimir the error avalanche no longer occurs and you can keep on playing.
You can load the game saved at the end of the main questline (just before reading the last letter).
Landplot development prices have changed.
Blowing up ruined houses yields more construction materials now.
Phillip's horse racing gate are better at riders detection.
You cannot jump while riding an animal when overburdened.
Fluffy can no longer replicate after racing.
In Own Rules mode, with immoratlity turned on, character state icons no longer blink in and out.
Haystands should not cause errors anymore and they will not trip over for no reason.
Engines, tablesaws and cutters don't become trippable after returning to farm area.
You may (again) build inside the barn on the ground floor.
Unpainted, player built fences and gates are properly snowed now.
Expanding your dugout will not cause savegame file problems anymore.
Changes made to farm's terrain (plowing, pathmaking, etc.) are restrored. No more grass texture under crops.
Winter party in the garage is over. Neon pink snow became and ordinary white one.
Prankster who kept covering indoor chests with snow learned a solid lesson.
Small chests may be placed inside the house now. So may be the big ones, but it's not a good idea.
You can place chests on barn's upper floor. Yes, hay, grass, straw, etc. still works up there.
A miracle happened in Zalesie. The time flows as it used to, but the days are longer. You can sleep less and work more now!
Trader NPCs opening hours are longer too.
The winter is not only way more efficient, but also more easy on the eyes.
Zalesie sounds different now. Matthew's prayers have been answered and the relentless wind is quieter now.
Kasimir learned how to build more storage structures: a small chest, a toolshed and a big storage shed.
You can increase capacity of the dugout by the house. Ask Anthony at the State Farm for such services.
Kasimir has learned how to distinguish grass from hay. Hay is a well dried grass, so you can dry your grass now using new haystands.
The hay replaced the grass in trade and some of the animals like eating it. The hay does not rot.
Throwing grass or hay with a hayfork automatically creates interactive stacks.
The recently lowered income from hunting activities is increased now, and Kasimir works faster in his slaughter at the barn.
Kasimir learned how to fry poultry using his kitchen.
Kasimir decided it would be nice to clean up barn's intertior to get more free space.
Kasimir decided he doesn't always need a company to improve his mood with a smoke. You can "consume" cigarettes alone and anytime you like.
Helen always gives mash recipes for the alcohols she wants Kasimir to prepare.
Kasimir sealed roof of contructions he built so the rain doesn't fall right trough them.
We managed to decrease memory usage significantly. Players who were forced to play using lowest texture quality may try increasing it now.
After harvesting the soil no longer claims there is still somethingh growing in it.
Fast travelling on bike or motorcycle no longer consumes unexpected amounts of time.
Selling animals no longer causes errors. You can sell chickens and roosters both in cages and released inside the selling pen.
You can no longer try to steal your own animals.
You can no longer reach stratoshpere flying on a freshly killed animal.
Numerous bugs concerning loading savegame files were fixed.
Trailer's sides check more precisely if they can close or not.
Engines carried in hands can no longer propel machines remotely.
Thadeus doesn't cheat about his wager with Kasimir.
Talking to the mayor no longer breaks fast travelling.
Main translation file for Korean language was corrected.
We are sorry for overwriting it with Chinese translation.
A bug making loading some of the savegame files impossible was fixed.
Feeding item problems were fixed.
Issues with some of the savegame files failing to load are fixed.
You can destroy fences without errors now.
You can put items down on the floor and hang them on walls.
We are sorry for the inconvenience.
Animal feeding items are being investigated now.

notes.title: New update have arrived in Zalesie

items.text: Watch📺 our new trailer✅
You can now mow the grass without worrying about the health of your computer. Yes, with a lawnmower, too.
Mowing grain and wheat also no longer leads to a slideshow.
Old overgrowth (located outside the available plots) is impossible to mow from now on.
A new tool has appeared in Zalesie: Bigger Forks. With their help, managing straw or dung becomes much easier.
Larger dead animals are now treated as large objects and must be carried in your hands. Remember fast travel and carts.
The farmer's eye also sees hunted animals barely visible in the forest cover from now on.
Hunted animals and snares are marked on the map from now on.
Casimir can determine his own fast travel point on the map.
Casimir's hearing has now improved. He noticed that the sounds sounded different depending on where he was, and there were slightly more of them.
Like dung, rotten products left to themselves automatically biodegrade after a while.

The prologue and demo of our game has finally been updated to better represent the current state of the project.: Just to let you know our friends from Mercat Games are releasing first ever pirate🏴‍☠️ real time tactics strategy game ➡️ Frigato: Shadows of the Caribbean: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1667750/Frigato_Shadows_of_the_Caribbean: We have just uploaded their funny trailer featuring devs themselves👀
Tadeusz starts a new business: Paid services for recovering lost objects (also from under water).
Tutorial was extended to explain leading animals in and out of their pens and to show rules of proper use of rifles.
Building quests are now checked for completion with 100% accuracy.
Kasimir learned to thread more quietly.
You can get off your motorcycle when you run out of fuel while driving fast.
Stringspool is more efficient and squeezes more content inside the bales.
Dead animals (only the biggest) will no longer fit inside Kasimir's pockets.
New, much more efficient grass system.
Physics of the trailers was stabilized. They will no longer fly around for no reason.
You can now lift treelogs you loaded on your carts and trailers without having to reload the game.
Building permission cost for Kasimir's farm was reduced, so it's easier to build new crates for storage now.
The bridge by the sawmill is no longer full of (invisible) holes.
Carts no longer displace their cargo when fast travelling
Time flows a bit slower in Zalesie and fast travelling is a bit faster.
You can grab your chickens and put them into crates now.
Kasimir understood that chickens - even when they are in crates - need freedom and you just can't squeeze them into bags or chests.
So, to sell chickens you need to place crates containing them inside the designated pen. Just like you do with other farm animals for sale.
Larger items (like engine or chaffcutter) must be carried around now. They no longer fit inside Kasimir's pockets. Fortunately, you can still use fast travel while carrying such items.
Kasimir learned how to throw items he's carrying. (Only tree logs are too heavy for such activities.)
Carts and trailers learned a new trick. Just drop items on them and they will try to take care of the rest.
There is a new option in game settings that lets you disable autosave feature.
Parked vehicles will no longer roll indefinitely when they are pushed.
You can start selling butter at the State Farm now.
Grass, straw, oat and wheat take less space in bags, chests and inventory.
Dead animals treated like large items. (No more carrying dead cows in your pockets).
Tadeusz starts a new business: Paid services for recovering lost objects (also from under water).

releases.displayName: Developers' view of the latest update

items.text: Dear Farmer's Life fans,
First of all, we would like to apologize to unsatisfied players about the latest update. You certainly want to know why some of the changes are controversial.

At the beginning of our journey, and even after the game's release in early access on Steam, we never expected that such a large number of fantastic players would take interest in our game, create a thriving community, and play, play, play, and play some more. Due to the fact that we are a small studio, on the one hand this is our first experience with such player support, on the other hand, when releasing/designing the game it was difficult to predict that a few years later there may be a situation of stability and performance problems due to, for example, too many animals.

Our intention has never been to make the enjoyment of the game unpleasant for players, but to provide constantly new experiences but also challenges. For the aforementioned reason, an update allowing us to continue adding content had to come. We were so anxious for you to have fun that it comes too late. We understand your bitterness, we treat everything with the utmost seriousness and promise that with this update, others with numerous and interesting mechanics, equipment and events will come soon.
We hope you will understand, and continue to support us, and we will continue to work hard and provide you with constantly new experiences, with the lowest possible percentage of those
negative ones.
Remember, you can always contact us on discord: Discord.
Greetings,
Farmer's Life team
Capacity of all the sacks, bags and boxes was increased to make transporting goods easier.
Capacity of all chests and inhouse storage was increased.
Autosave works even when the player doesn't sleep at all and activates every 20 minutes.
